_readme: Homepage content, top to bottom. Images live in assets/img/site/<image>.jpg (+ .webp and -640.webp). Links are relative to the site root. Edit, then run: python3 build.py

hero.text: Coats, knitwear, shirts and trousers in natural fibres. One collection, kept in every size, season after season.

spotlight.text: Dense organic cotton jersey with a ribbed collar that holds its shape. Cut once, kept in every size.
